name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that upgrades AI coding assistants with better memory, safety checks, and smarter workflows, aiming to make their output closer to a skilled human engineer's.
buyer: A dev-tools startup, or an engineering org running multiple AI coding agents, that wants to boost their reliability and output quality without switching tools entirely.
business_use_cases: An AI coding-agent SaaS integrates its optimization techniques to differentiate its product from competitors.
A dev agency adopts it internally to get more reliable output from its AI-assisted workflow, taking on more billable client work.
A consultancy sells 'AI agent tuning' services to companies already using coding agents but unhappy with output quality.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 'AI agent tuning/optimization' consulting engagements to companies using coding agents
License the underlying techniques into a commercial coding-agent product

steal_this: This weekend, benchmark one popular coding agent's output before and after applying its techniques, publish the results, and use it as a lead magnet for a paid 'agent tuning' offer.
